mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer spending, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a positive RSAFS month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and below-average inflation (CPIAUCSL < 12-month moving average) signals a deflationary environment that prompts aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and CPIAUCSL < 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), a month-over-month decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5% and UNRATE shows a month-over-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600,000 units per month, it signals a rebound in the housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95 (index, 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a positive month-over-month change in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates accelerating consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during the post-recession recovery regime when RSAFS shows a positive month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising inflation, which leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with a positive CPIAUCSL month-over-month change.
